name: confocal-ellipse-bridge-synthesis
title: Shifted Mellin Bridge Decomposition, Diagonal Stieltjes Tail Bounds, and Off-Diagonal Obstructions for Euler-Sieved Approximations to Riemann's Xi-Function
summary: Establishes the Riemann-type three-part shifted Mellin bridge decomposition for Xi(t - i*d)*E_X(s) with closed incomplete-Gamma shells, unconditional Rosser-Schoenfeld Stieltjes upper bounds for the L^2 diagonal prime sum on X >= sqrt(N(t)), and Mertens' harmonic benchmark, while proving four structural obstructions (reflected-branch asymmetry, L^1 divergence under true n^{-1/2} weights, off-diagonal cancellation, and Voronin universality) that preclude phase-blind zero-free closure on d > 1/4.
